This morning I was notified of another death in ICE custody — the 48th death since Trump returned to office.

There must be urgent accountability and oversight, and Congress must take action to dismantle ICE and CBP.

Today we start AANHPI Heritage Month! As the first South Asian woman elected to the House of Representatives, I am so proud to be a part of this beautiful and vibrant community.

Let us honor the contributions, culture, and history of AANHPI communities this month and every day.

I voted no because we need real warrant reforms that the majority of us on both sides want instead of just extending with no reforms. I promise another extension will NOT get through on suspension. Fix the damn thing so we stop the warrantless spying on Americans.


Jake Sherman (@JakeSherman)
